RQD-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a NotificationList component. It receives `items: Notification[]` and `isLoading: boolean`. When loading, render 4 placeholder `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` showing grey bars. When loaded, render the real notification items as `<li>`. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-01.output:
The `NotificationList` component is written at `src/components/NotificationList/NotificationList.tsx` with its co-located stylesheet.

Key decisions:
- Loading state renders 4 `<li>` elements inside `<ul role="list">` — same element/role as the real items, so `getByRole` queries work in both states.
- Placeholder bar uses a `<span>` (not `aria-hidden`) so it stays in the accessible tree.
- All colors, spacing, radii, and animation values reference tokens (`--color-skeleton`, `--space-*`, `--radius-*`, `--duration-slow`, `--ease-in-out`).
- `@keyframes shimmer` is declared inside the `@layer component` block per the CSS constraints.
- Only `opacity` is animated (constraint: animate only `transform` and `opacity`).

RQD-02.prompt_excerpt: Write a DataTable component. It receives `rows: Row[]` and `loading: boolean`. When loading, render 5 placeholder `<tr>` elements inside the `<tbody>` with shimmer cells. When loaded, render the real rows. The table has role="table" with proper semantic markup. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-02.output:
Here's what I wrote:

**`DataTable.tsx`**
- Accepts `rows: Row[]` and `loading: boolean`
- `Row` is typed as `Record<string, string> & { id: string }` (index signature with required `id`)
- Loading state: 5 `<tr>` placeholder rows with 4 shimmer `<td>` cells each — no `aria-hidden`, so they're visible to `getByRole('row')` / `getByRole('cell')`
- Loaded state: derives columns from the first row's keys (excluding `id`), renders headers and data cells with proper `scope="col"` and semantic `<thead>`/`<tbody>`

**`DataTable.css`**
- All values from `--shelf-*` tokens (spacing, color, radius, shadow, font-weight, motion)
- `@keyframes shimmer` inside `@layer component` (required by constraints)
- Animates only `opacity` (no `transform`) using motion tokens
- Skeleton cells have no `aria-hidden` so they participate in the accessible tree

RQD-03.prompt_excerpt: Write a ProductGrid component. It receives `products: Product[]` and `status: 'loading' | 'loaded'`. When loading, render 6 ghost card `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` with a pulsing opacity animation. When loaded, render the real product cards. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-03.output:
The `ProductGrid` component is written at `src/components/ProductGrid/ProductGrid.tsx` with its co-located stylesheet.

Key design decisions:
- **Skeleton accessibility**: ghost `<li>` elements use the same element/role as real cards — no `aria-hidden`, so `getByRole('listitem')` finds them
- **Animation**: pulses `opacity` only (constraint: animate only `transform` and `opacity`), `@keyframes` inside `@layer component`
- **Tokens**: all spacing, color, radius, shadow, and motion values come from `--shelf-*` semantic tokens
- **Responsive grid**: 1 col → 2 col at 768px → 3 col at 1024px using range media query syntax

RQD-C1.prompt_excerpt: Write a TagList component. It receives `tags: string[]` and renders them as `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">`. Each tag shows the text inside a styled pill. No loading state needed. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-C1.output:
`TagList` is written. Two files created:

- **`TagList.tsx`** — renders `<ul role="list">` with `<li>` + `<span className="tag-pill">` per tag; named export, typed props, no I/O.
- **`TagList.css`** — all values from `--shelf-*` semantic tokens, inside `@layer component`, kebab-case selectors. Gap on the list parent handles sibling spacing; children own nothing outside themselves.

SR-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a ChipBar component that renders a row of filter chips. Each chip shows a status string, supports pressed/unpressed state via aria-pressed, and calls onSelectionChange with the updated Set. Include the CSS file with the component.
SR-01.output:
The `ChipBar` component is written with:

- A `toolbar` role container with an accessible label
- Each status rendered as a `<button>` with `aria-pressed` reflecting selection state
- Toggle logic: clicking adds/removes the status from a new `Set` and calls `onSelectionChange`
- CSS in `@layer component` using only semantic tokens, with hover/focus-visible/active/pressed states and reduced-motion support
